projects.name: SMP2 Digital Transformation
projects.text: Data-driven heat-cycle analysis identifies 25.6 h of recoverable furnace time (~15 additional heats) by bringing slower heats to the median tap-to-tap time (79 min). Quickest gains: blowing (7.0 min/heat above median) and arcing (10.5 min/heat above median) in the slowest quarter of heats. Aligning Conarc3 to Conarc2 adds ~1.8 h.
